narr: On May 6th, scattered storms produced large hail and heavy rainfall across portions of western Wisconsin. In Monroe County, a slow moving storm produced localized flash flooding near Warrens.
ev: Many area roads near Warrens, WI were closed and covered with water and debris. Most notable closures were in the area of US HWY 12 and CO HWY EW. Water Depth of 3 to 4 feet was noted in some places.
